entries.author: AI/quality-followup-author-a

alternatives.meaning:
n. 大桶
vt. 装入大桶, 在大桶里处理

entries.reason: The lower-case vat noun and transitive verb are directly verified as vessel and putting/treating in a vat. Preserve separately from capital VAT tax. Retained old form vats must never gain the tax meaning.
entries.usageNote: 普通名词 vat 的大桶及装桶用法，区别于税种缩写 VAT。

entries.author: AI/quality-followup-author-a

alternatives.meaning: abbr. 商学士（Bachelor of Science in Commerce）

entries.reason: B.S.C. is explicitly listed as Bachelor of Science in Commerce, separately from BSc Bachelor of Science. The current Chinese Commerce degree gloss has a defensible distinct expansion; do not erase it through case folding.
entries.usageNote: 这里的缩写展开为 Bachelor of Science in Commerce，指商科相关学位。

entries.author: AI/quality-followup-author-a

alternatives.meaning: n. 鞋匠工头, (英)排字工头

entries.reason: Collins explicitly lists an informal foreman in a shoe factory or printing works. The whole existing noun tuple is supported and is distinct from the hand-held classroom device.
entries.usageNote: 非正式的工厂或印刷行业用语，指工头。

entries.author: AI/quality-followup-author-a

alternatives.meaning: 汉瑟姆(姓氏)

entries.reason: Hansom is a verified surname, including cab inventor Joseph Hansom in the Science Museum record. The capitalised surname must remain distinguished from the common-noun cab sense.
entries.usageNote: 姓氏，通常首字母大写为 Hansom。

entries.author: AI/quality-followup-author-a

alternatives.meaning: n. 荡妇, 娼妓

entries.reason: The US person senses are documented separately from the British chip shop. Preserve only with explicit US/slang/derogatory context in the display; neither person sense is a shop synonym.
entries.usageNote: 美式旧俚语，含贬义或冒犯意味，不宜随便用来称呼他人。

entries.author: AI/quality-followup-author-a

alternatives.meaning: vi. 得意扬扬地行进

entries.reason: Collins records a now-rare intransitive triumphant/self-satisfied movement sense, separately from heavy clumsy movement. The old definition is not wholly wrong and must not be silently removed.
entries.usageNote: 较少见或旧式用法，表示得意扬扬地行进。

entries.author: AI/quality-followup-author-a

alternatives.meaning: [医] 直接离心浮选[法]

entries.reason: A primary Warwick thesis explicitly defines and discusses Direct Centrifugal Flotation (DCF). The old medical procedure meaning can remain separate from finance; its existing noun label denotes the named method.
entries.usageNote: 医学或寄生虫检验用语，与财务上的折现现金流缩写分开。

entries.author: AI/root-example-followup-b

alternatives.meaning: n. 受雇于同一老板的拳击手

entries.reason: 原名词释义所指的拳击手同属一位经营者或经理，是 stablemate 的有效引申义；与本次新写的同厩马义不同，保留来源选项。MW 的 stablemate 第二义指 stable 的成员，stable 明列同一管理下的拳击手；Collins 与拳击器材商自己的术语表相互支持。

entries.author: AI/root-example-followup-b

alternatives.meaning: 以总统[议长、校长等]的资格

entries.reason: 原副词释义是以 president 身份行事；MW 的精确 presidentially 词条明确该身份义，其 president 条目另列会议主持者、机构负责人、college president 与国家元首，因此原完整括注可以保留。该身份义不等同本次新例句的总统风范方式义。

entries.author: AI/root-example-followup-b

alternatives.meaning: abbr. 印度联合新闻社（United News of India）

entries.reason: UNI 是 United News of India 的确立简称，原 abbreviation 词性和整个机构名称释义有效。机构自己发布的 About UNI 明确该全称和缩写。它与本次英式口语 university 义不同，保留原来源选项，不宣称大学例句覆盖新闻社义。

alternatives.meaning:
n. 装饰, 装饰品
vt. 装饰

entries.reason: I read the complete noun/verb decoration tuple. Merriam-Webster separately attests a decorative object or embellishment and the verb decorate, so both components of the unchanged MIT tuple can remain alongside the new legal verb.

alternatives.meaning:

[法] 重大的, 主要的, 伟大的

[法] 重大的, 主要的, 伟大的

entries.reason: I read both identical core/MIT adjective tuples, including their legal-marked tail. Grand covers impressive scale and splendor, dignity, distinction, importance or high rank, and haughty self-importance. These are separate adjective uses; the bracketed label does not establish an exclusive legal technical sense.
entries.usageNote: 这里保留原有形容词用法；金额名词的复数仍用 grand，grander、grandest 属于形容词变化。

entries.author: AI/common-class-vocabulary-author

alternatives.meaning: a. 专注的, 献身的
a. 专注的, 献身的

entries.reason: Both complete adjective tuples describe commitment or devotion and are supported as adjective uses about people or their commitment. They are valid distinct alternatives to the selected object-purpose sense.
entries.usageNote: 形容人时还可表示专注、投入或献身；这里与专用于某项用途的意思分开。

entries.author: AI/common-class-vocabulary-author

alternatives.meaning: adv. 实质上, 本质上, 大体上
adv. 实质上, 本质上, 大体上

entries.reason: Both full adverb tuples cover the essential/mostly sense, not only degree. Collins distinguishes largely correct or unchanged from large amounts of change. The old Chinese glosses are context-dependent paraphrases of the former.
entries.usageNote: 也可表示大体上、实质上；大幅增加与大体相同须按语境区分。

entries.author: AI/common-class-vocabulary-author

alternatives.meaning: a. 陡峭的, 轻率的

entries.reason: The entire old adjective tuple has two components: steep and hasty/rash. Collins attests both and explicitly records disagreement over the hasty use. Retention is acceptable with that caveat; it is not certification that the original example illustrates every component.
entries.usageNote: 另有陡峭义；表示轻率、仓促行动的用法虽有收录，但存在用法争议。

entries.author: AI/common-class-vocabulary-author

alternatives.meaning:
n. 命令, 指令, 要求
vt. 委任统治

entries.reason: The complete noun/verb tuple is supported: command or authoritative instruction as noun, and assigning a territory under the historical League of Nations mandate as verb. The historic role is not a contemporary synonym for every act of requiring.
entries.usageNote: 命令、指令是名词用法；委任统治属于历史语境，与正式强制要求分开。

n. (政府提供的)钱和设备, 准备, 供应品, 规定, 条款
vt. 供给...食物及必需品

entries.reason: I read both complete mixed-POS tuples. They cover supplied resources, advance preparation, supplies, formal conditions/clauses, and supplying food or necessities as verb. These are attested. Government money/equipment is a context in which resources are supplied, not an exclusive provider restriction.
entries.usageNote: 供应品通常用复数 provisions；条款、预先作安排及提供食物的动词义须分开理解。

entries.author: AI/common-class-vocabulary-author

alternatives.meaning: pl. 男毕业生, 男校友

entries.reason: The full pos-reviewed noun tuple names the traditional male plural of alumnus and remains valid for that scope. The Wisconsin primary style guide confirms the male plural and also mixed-gender alumni; retaining the male case must not make it an exclusive restriction.
entries.usageNote: 原释保留传统男性复数用法；现代 alumni 也常指不同性别组成的校友群体。

entries.reason: Both full mixed-POS tuples are supported for failure of obligation/payment/appearance and the automatic preset or fallback choice/value, including technical uses. Their noun and verb components are separately attested and remain valid beyond the selected shared-desk arrangement.

entries.author: AI/common-class-vocabulary-author

alternatives.meaning: 指望, 想以廉价买

entries.reason: I read the complete expectation/cheap-purchase tuple rather than approving only its first half. Collins specifically attests expect/count on and try to get cheaply for bargain for. Both can remain as alternatives to negotiating for employment or contract terms.

entries.author: AI/common-class-vocabulary-author

alternatives.meaning: 走运, 发现丰富的矿藏

entries.reason: The full original tuple is acceptable only with financial context for 走运: Collins attests rich mineral/oil discoveries and sudden or unexpected financial success. It does not support replacing the idiom with general luck in unrelated matters.
entries.usageNote: 这里的走运指意外取得财务成功；发现富矿是传统用法，不泛指任何好运。
